duckrun.n: merge_clauses do_nothing is a DuckDB anti-join plus a plain append: no delta-rs merge pool, no file rewritten.

spark.n: dbt-spark merges update + insert: a matched key updates. That only happens when two runs fold the same file.

polars.n: dbt-polars has no merge_clauses (dbt-polars#32): up to 0.3.1 it was silently ignored and a do-nothing merge UPDATED matched rows; 0.4.0 rejects it. Here: append, excluding files already folded.

duckrun.n: delta-rs merge. It scales with the target's partition span, not the batch, which is why the facts prefer the insert-only form.

iceberg.n: The OneLake Iceberg catalog rejects data files + delete files in one commit: BadRequest 400, "Only one instance of each update type is allowed per request".

ducklake.n: DuckLake can. fct_summary gives it up so the three DuckDB trees run one config.

polars.n: A merge updates matched rows; there is no clause to ask it not to.

ducklake.n: The catalog SQL DB is the state.

spark.n: A fresh runner's metastore is empty: is_incremental() is false and every incremental model silently rebuilds. spark_session.py registers every Delta table before dbt starts.

polars.n: The OneLake REST catalog is the state.

duckrun.n: read_csv with all_varchar, null_padding, ignore_errors and auto_detect=false. With auto-detect on, DuckDB infers a narrower layout from the first record type it sees.

spark.n: Just reads it: USING csv with an explicit STRING schema and mode PERMISSIVE pads short rows and drops extra fields, no questions asked.

polars.n: Polars SQL read_csv(), ONE FILE PER CALL joined by UNION ALL, with a fixed VARCHAR schema, missing_columns => 'insert' and truncate_ragged_lines (missing_columns is in SQL only on Polars main, pola-rs/polars#29975). A folder glob reads every file: no list of paths in SQL (pola-rs/polars#29969).

rows.label: A view in the target database

iceberg.n: The Iceberg catalog has no CREATE VIEW: the model declares database='memory', a view that dies with the process. So dbt retry cannot re-run a node that reads it, and --full-refresh fails (no rename): a reset is a DROP.

polars.n: No shared session: every model is its own Polars SQLContext, so the archive log is a table rebuilt every run.

iceberg.n: Two on dbt-duckdb 1.11.0: DESCRIBE must filter Iceberg's hidden __ column, DROP must omit CASCADE. Both branch on target.name, because ducklake is type duckdb too.

ducklake.n: None: upstream already omits CASCADE for DuckLake.

polars.n: None: the models work around the adapter instead.

rows.label: A macro that reads a model (run-operation)

spark.n: In-process through a dbtRunner callback: a separate run-operation would start a JVM without the session spark_session.py built.

polars.n: dbt run-operation parity_fingerprint, since 0.4.0 (dbt-polars#39). Before, run-operation never filled the relation cache and the fingerprint went through dbt show.

duckrun.n: The adapter's token chain finds the az CLI login.

iceberg.n: Two: the ATTACH bearer for the catalog, which vends a per-table SAS for Tables/ (duckdb-iceberg#1331), plus an azure secret for Files/. Vending covers Tables/ only.

ducklake.n: Two bearers: OneLake storage, and database.windows.net for the catalog SQL DB (forwarded as meta_access_token).

spark.n: Hadoop ABFS has no Azure CLI credential: WorkloadIdentityTokenProvider reads the job's GitHub OIDC token from a file rewritten every four minutes.

polars.n: Polars SQL read_csv() takes no credential: AZURE_STORAGE_TOKEN in the environment.

iceberg.n: OneLake vends nothing on createTable and rejects the follow-up metadata update: stage_create_tables: 0 and skip_create_table_metadata_updates: 1. default_schema must name a namespace that exists (dbo).

ducklake.n: The catalog SQL DB needs COLLATE Latin1_General_100_BIN2_UTF8 at creation, and shaping a fresh catalog takes minutes: three mssql timeouts at 600 s.

spark.n: Delta, once the schemas are created with LOCATION <lakehouse>/Tables/<schema>.

polars.n: The REST catalog is a service.

ducklake.n: DuckLake parquet, plus delta_export() (no arguments) writing each table's _delta_log in place, which is why data_path is the lakehouse's Tables/.

spark.n: STRING != 0 casts the string to INT, which truncates: '0.5' != 0 is false. A bare SCADAVALUE != 0 dropped 12-16% of the intraday SCADA rows. Cast to DOUBLE.

polars.n: Columns are strings here; the filter casts to DOUBLE explicitly.

spark.n: CAST(string AS TIMESTAMP) returns NULL for slashes instead of erroring. to_timestamp(..., 'yyyy/MM/dd HH:mm:ss').

spark.n: strftime -> date_format, INTERVAL -> date_sub, TIMESTAMPTZ -> TIMESTAMP, no DOUBLE PRECISION, split_part -> substring_index.

polars.n: Only on a pinned Polars main build: the IN-subquery and nested-WITH scoping fixes, TIMESTAMPTZ and generate_series (#29876-#29879) are not in a release.
No current_date / current_timestamp / now() in Polars SQL, by any spelling (pola-rs/polars#28798).
